extracted.name: Easy Shrimp Dip
extracted.description: This cream cheese shrimp dip is super easy to make with canned shrimp and cocktail sauce for a last-minute party appetizer that’s sure to please!
instruction_lines: Place softened cream cheese in the center of a serving platter and spread into an even layer.
Stir cocktail sauce and drained shrimp together in a small bowl until well combined. Spoon the shrimp mixture evenly over the cream cheese.
Serve immediately with crackers, or cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.
